basic_details.job_title: ESIC Udyogamandal Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 40 Super Specialist, Specialist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Hospital, Udyogamandal, Ernakulam District, Kerala, will hold a walk-in interview for doctors (allopathy) on 2 December 2026. Reporting time is 9:00 AM and registration runs from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The Medical Superintendent has invited candidates for 2 Full Time/Part Time Super Specialist, 11 Full Time/Part Time Specialist and 27 Senior Resident (1 year) posts on contract, with consolidated remuneration from Rs 60,000 to Rs 2,40,000 a month depending on post and level.

Pay: an amount of Rs 1,688/- will be deducted for Senior Residents possessing only a Diploma, and Rs 2,813/- if the Senior Resident has neither a Diploma nor a Degree. Remuneration is paid as per orders issued by ESIC Headquarters from time to time.

important_instructions: Only candidates with TCMC/MCI degree registration may attend the walk-in interview. Private practice of any kind will not be allowed for FTS. Vacancies will be determined as per availability of vacant posts and published on the hospital website (www.esic.gov.in). Corrigenda, if any, will be published only on the website. In case of any confusion or ambiguity, the English version of the notice shall prevail.

content_sections.heading: About ESIC Udyogamandal
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Medical Superintendent of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Hospital at Udyogamandal in Ernakulam, Kerala. The hospital proposes to conduct the walk-in interview for contract engagement of doctors in the allopathy stream. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to cancel the recruitment and to increase or decrease vacancies as per actual requirement on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Experience: FTSS entry level – Nil. FTSS senior level – 5 years experience in respective specialty after PG. Age: not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview; relaxation for reserved categories as per rules. Tenure beyond 70 years is not permitted. Note for Oncology: if no eligible candidate with super specialty qualification in oncology applies, a specialist with radiotherapy qualification (MDRT/DNB RT or Diploma in RT), with 3 years experience for a degree holder and 5 years for a diploma holder, may be considered in specialist scale. Part time remuneration: fixed amount for 4 days x 4 hours a week; emergency visit charges Rs 20,000/- if willing; additional Rs 1,200/- (entry) or Rs 1,500/- (senior) for every hour beyond 16 hours a week, which the Medical Superintendent must justify. ICU: PG Degree / Diploma in Critical Care/Anaesthesia/General Medicine and Pulmonary Medicine. Casualty: preference to Postgraduates in Critical Care. If a Critical Care specialist is not available, PG Degree / Diploma in Anaesthesia/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine or Paediatrics may be considered. Experience: FTS (entry level) and PTS – PG Degree with 3 years' experience or PG Diploma with 5 years experience in respective specialty after PG. FTS (senior level) – PG Degree with 5 years' experience or PG Diploma with 7 years experience in respective specialty after PG. Age: Full Time Specialist – not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview, with relaxation for reserved categories as per rules. Part Time Specialist – not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview. Part time remuneration: Rs 60,000/- fixed for 4 hours x 4 days a week; emergency visit charges Rs 15,000/- if willing; Rs 800/- for every hour beyond 16 hours a week, to be justified by the Medical Superintendent. If PG candidates are not available, candidates with 2 years experience after MBBS, of which one year must be in the concerned specialty from a government or reputed private hospital, will be considered. PG doctors will be given preference in Casualty and Surgery Departments. Candidates who have completed 3 years Senior Residency from any Govt. Institute need not appear for interview for the post of Senior Resident. Age: not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview; relaxation for reserved categories as per rules. Pay: an amount of Rs 1,688/- will be deducted for Senior Residents possessing only a Diploma, and Rs 2,813/- if the Senior Resident has neither a Diploma nor a Degree. Remuneration is paid as per orders issued by ESIC Headquarters from time to time.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Udyogamandal Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 40 vacancies in all. Where no candidate is available in an advertised category, the post may be filled for 45 days through UR candidates. The vacancies may change on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Udyogamandal Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Working hours: 09.00 AM to 04.00 PM on week days and 09.00 AM to 01.00 PM on Saturdays. Should attend emergency visit as and when it is required. Working hours: 09.00 AM to 04.00 PM on week days and 09.00 AM to 01.00 PM on Saturdays. Should attend emergency visit as and when it is required. The specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in his discipline. Available on call 24x7. Minimum working hours will be 16 per week (4 hours x 4 days per week). The specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in his discipline. Available on call 24x7 for those who are willing to draw emergency call charges. To work as per ESIC norms for Senior Residency.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure II of the notice), with one recent passport size photograph affixed on it. All original documents and one set of photocopy of all original documents. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates: valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority not below the rank of Tahsildar/Sub Divisional Officer, as per DOPT, GOI circular No36039/1/2019 dated 31.01.2019. The OBC certificate must be in the prescribed form and certify that the candidate does not belong to any of the Creamy Layers. Candidates retired from a state/central government hospital: Pension Payment Order and pay slip of the last pay drawn during service. Demand Draft for the application fee, as below. The fee is paid by Demand Draft drawn in favour of ESI Fund Account No.1, payable at SBI, Kalamassery.

rows.fee: Rs 250/- (Rupees two hundred and fifty only)

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration is from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM on 02.12.2026; reporting time is 09:00 AM. Candidates arriving after 9:15 AM will not be permitted to participate in the interview process. The notice names a walk-in interview as the selection route. For Senior Resident, candidates who completed 3 years Senior Residency from any Govt. Institute need not appear for interview. Vacancies may change as per actual requirement on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: FTSS and FTS: one year on contract or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier; extendable for a maximum of 3 years based on satisfactory performance. PTSS and PTS: one year on contract or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Full time contract specialists: recruited for 3 years with annual evaluation, with the term renewed every year based on satisfactory performance. Private practice is not allowed; leave is 4 days for each month of work on pro rata basis, encashable up to 30 days a year if not availed. Part time contract specialists: contract of one year from the date of joining; not entitled to any kind of leave or benefits. Professional indemnity policy: minimum sum assured per annum Rs 30 lakh for Anaesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc.; Rs 20 lakh for General Surgeons, Gynaecologists, Obstetricians etc.; at least Rs 10 lakh for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc. A copy of the policy, premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates with TCMC/MCI degree registration may attend the walk-in interview. Private practice of any kind will not be allowed for FTS. No TA/DA will be admissible for the walk-in interview. Canvassing in any form shall be disqualification. Vacancies will be determined as per availability of vacant posts and published on the hospital website ( www.esic.gov.in ). Corrigenda, if any, will be published only on the website. In case of any confusion or ambiguity, the English version of the notice shall prevail.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ESIC Udyogamandal walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 02.12.2026 (2 December 2026). Reporting time is 09:00 AM and registration runs from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the ESIC Udyogamandal walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The venue is ESIC Hospital, Udyogamandal, Ernakulam District, Kerala. The notice prints no PIN code.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Hospital Udyogamandal?
faq.answer: The notice lists 40 vacancies: 2 Full Time/Part Time Super Specialist, 11 Full Time/Part Time Specialist and 27 Senior Resident (1 year) posts. Vacancies may change on the interview date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Senior Resident at ESIC Udyogamandal?
faq.answer: A PG Degree or PG Diploma in the concerned specialty is required. If PG candidates are not available, candidates with 2 years experience after MBBS, including one year in the concerned specialty in a government or reputed private hospital, will be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Udyogamandal posts?
faq.answer: Super Specialist and Specialist: not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview. Senior Resident: not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Reserved categories get relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for ESIC Udyogamandal Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Full Time Specialist gets a consolidated Rs 1,55,044/- (entry level) or Rs 1,76,541/- (senior level). Part Time Specialist gets Rs 60,000/- fixed. Super Specialist pay is Rs 2,00,000/- to Rs 2,40,000/- (full time) and Rs 1,00,000/- to Rs 1,50,000/- (part time).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the ESIC Udyogamandal walk-in?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates pay Rs 250/- and SC/ST candidates pay Rs 50/-, by Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund Account No.1 payable at SBI, Kalamassery. PWD and female applicants are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I carry to the ESIC Udyogamandal walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry the application in the prescribed proforma with a recent passport size photograph affixed, all original documents and one set of photocopies. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates need a caste certificate, and retired government doctors need the Pension Payment Order and last pay slip.

faq.question: Q9. Are these ESIC Udyogamandal posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, they are contract posts. FTSS and FTS are for one year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years on satisfactory performance. PTSS and PTS are for one year or till the regular incumbent joins.

faq.question: Q10. Will late arrivals be allowed at the ESIC Udyogamandal walk-in?
faq.answer: No. Candidates arriving after 9:15 AM will not be permitted to participate in the interview process.
